scope: Fixed16 TRAIN batches, M95 eval forward. Only the last encoder layer uses cluster attention (cluster_att_num_layers=1). Dropping a scale zeroes that scale's message inside the unchanged learned per-point gate; the gate is softmax over three scales, so remaining weights are not renormalised. Cosine duplication is over target superpoints only. Forward-only intervention: it does not undo training effects and is not a novel variant. No model, novelty, efficacy or resource admission.
